cards.title: 0.1 Architecture document and foundational ADRs
cards.description:
## 🎯 Goal
Record the architecture and technical decisions before coding starts so that every later card is built on the same foundation.

## 📋 Work
Create docs/architecture.md with a (Mermaid) diagram separating the data plane (apps/gateway) from the control plane (apps/control-api, apps/worker, apps/dashboard), the path of a request from Traefik to the provider, and the path of a usage event to Postgres. Write ADRs in docs/adr/: ADR-001 gateway on NestJS over Fastify and ways to reduce overhead; ADR-002 PostgreSQL + Prisma; ADR-003 Valkey for counters/cache/pub-sub; ADR-004 Traefik v3 as the reverse proxy; ADR-005 BullMQ for the event queue; ADR-006 the principle "the data plane does not depend on the control plane". Move docs/research/feature-comparison.md into the repository.

## ✅ Acceptance criteria
- [ ] docs/architecture.md exists with a Mermaid diagram and a description of the request path
- [ ] Six ADRs are written using the Context / Decision / Consequences template
- [ ] A glossary of concepts (Provider, Credential, Model, Alias, Combo, Virtual Key, Budget) is in docs/glossary.md

## 🔧 Technical notes
ADR template: MADR. Technical terms stay in English.

## 🏁 Definition of Done (DoD)
- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests are written and green in CI
- [ ] Relevant documentation in docs/ is updated
- [ ] Run and verified in the docker compose environment
- [ ] Code review completed and approved

cards.title: 2.3 Traefik reverse-proxy configuration
cards.description:
## 🎯 Goal
All inbound traffic goes through Traefik, with TLS, security headers, and correct streaming support.

## 📋 Work
Static configuration (traefik.yml): web/websecure entrypoints, redirect to HTTPS, Docker provider (exposedByDefault=false) and file provider, JSON access log, Prometheus metrics, Traefik dashboard behind basicAuth and ipAllowList. Dynamic configuration: routers for api.<DOMAIN> → gateway, admin.<DOMAIN> → control-api, app.<DOMAIN> → dashboard. Middlewares: security headers, CORS for control-api, compress with excludedContentTypes=text/event-stream, edge rate limit for control-api. Long timeouts for SSE (respondingTimeouts and serversTransport.forwardingTimeouts), gateway service healthCheck to take unhealthy replicas out of rotation. TLS: Let's Encrypt (HTTP-01, optional DNS-01) in production, a local certificate for *.localhost in dev.

## ✅ Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A long stream (10 minutes) passes through Traefik without being cut off or buffered
- [ ] An unhealthy gateway replica is taken out of rotation within a few seconds
- [ ] Responses include HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy headers
- [ ] docs/traefik.md explains every router, middleware, and the reason for each timeout

## 🔧 Technical notes
deploy/traefik/traefik.yml and deploy/traefik/dynamic/*.yml; Docker labels for services.

## 🔗 Dependencies
